notes: Production images are built by the `production-image` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml after a Changesets release, not by deploy.yml, so the source-map build arguments and upload secret are passed there.
The root route renders the identity component only when `bundledPostHog` is set, matching the app's earlier behaviour.
src/routes/__root.tsx keeps the product's head tags, header, footer, toaster, and `meQuery` loader; the update notice uses the app's brass and floor colours instead of amber.
src/router.tsx keeps the app's `RouteError` default error component and its 'Nothing here' not-found page.
src/client/queryClient.ts also exports `errorMessage`, which the pages use to show a failed call's message.
src/server/contentSecurityPolicy.ts adds `worker-src 'self' blob:` for PostHog session replay's compression worker, as the app's previous policy allowed.
src/routes/api/health.ts maps a failure to `database_unavailable`, the code monitors already saw.
vite.config.ts keeps `server.allowedHosts: ['host.docker.internal']` only while the Centrifugo connect proxy calls back into the dev server.
AGENTS.md is a symlink to CLAUDE.md, which holds the recipe's paragraph beside the product's agent guide.
tsconfig.json keeps the `@/*` path alias and vitest.config.ts sets `resolve.tsconfigPaths`, because the shadcn components under src/components/ui import through `@/`.
.oxlintrc.json also ignores src/components/ui/**, which `shadcn add` generates.
pnpm-workspace.yaml keeps the peerDependencyRules entry that lets better-auth's better-sqlite3 peer range accept version 13.
